product_overview: A single-page personal portfolio that showcases biomedical engineering experience, clinical rotations, technical skills, credentials, and ways to contact the owner. Users can navigate between sections, inspect modal details, and submit an inquiry through the contact form.
core_goals: Browse the portfolio sections and review the owner’s background
View academic credentials and clinical rotation details in modal dialogs
Explore technical skills and capabilities across biomedical, IoT, and software domains
Send a message through the contact form and access direct contact methods

features.name: Navigation and Scroll Spy
features.description: Allows visitors to move through the portfolio sections quickly, monitor their position on the page, and open the mobile navigation menu on smaller screens.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a section link for About -> See the page scroll to the About section -> Click another section link for Experience -> See the page scroll to the Experience section -> Click a section link for Contact -> See the page scroll to the Contact section
Navigate to / -> Scroll through the page -> Observe the active navigation highlight update with the current section -> Observe the top progress bar advance as the page position changes
Navigate to / -> Open the mobile navigation menu -> Select a section link -> See the page scroll to the chosen section -> Close the mobile navigation menu
Navigate to / -> Select the Get In Touch action -> See the page scroll to the contact section

features.name: Hero Section and Credentials Modal
features.description: Presents the main introduction area with personal branding, quick actions, social profile links, and a modal for academic credentials.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the hero introduction and profile summary -> Open the credentials modal -> Review the academic credentials and CGPA -> Close the modal
Navigate to / -> Select the Hire Me action -> See the page scroll to the contact section
Navigate to / -> Select the Explore action -> See the page scroll to the clinical experience section
Navigate to / -> Open a social profile link -> View the corresponding external profile or contact destination

features.name: Clinical Rotations and Modal Breakdowns
features.description: Showcases hospital internship experiences and lets visitors open detailed breakdowns for each rotation in a modal dialog.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the detailed breakdown for Care24 Medical Centre -> Review the hospital rotation details in the modal -> Close the modal
Navigate to / -> Open the detailed breakdown for Maruthi Medical Centre -> Review the hospital rotation details in the modal -> Close the modal
Navigate to / -> Open a clinical rotation modal -> Press Escape to dismiss the modal
Navigate to / -> Open a clinical rotation modal -> Click outside the modal content -> Dismiss the modal

features.name: Skills Matrix and Capabilities
features.description: Displays grouped technical skills so visitors can review the user’s biomedical instrumentation, IoT hardware, and software capabilities.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the skills section -> Hover over skill badges and proficiency indicators -> Observe the associated capabilities and skill emphasis
Navigate to / -> Move across different skill groups -> Compare biomedical, IoT, and software skill categories

features.name: Contact Form Submission
features.description: Lets visitors send a message through a validated contact form and access direct contact options such as email, WhatsApp, and location details.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Scroll to the contact section -> Enter a name -> Enter an email address -> Enter a message -> Submit the form -> See the submission status update
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the contact section -> Leave a required field empty or enter an invalid email address -> Submit the form -> See a validation message
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the contact section -> Select the email contact link -> Open the email destination
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the contact section -> Select the WhatsApp contact link -> Open the WhatsApp destination
Navigate to / -> Scroll to the contact section -> Select the location details -> View the contact location information

routes.description: Single-page portfolio application showcasing biomedical engineering experience, IoT skills, clinical rotations, and contact form

features.name: Navigation and Scroll Spy
features.description: Header navigation with brand logo, section anchors, scroll spy active indicator, scroll progress bar, and mobile responsive menu toggle
user_interactions: Click navigation links (Home, About, Skills, Experience, Education, Certifications, Contact) to scroll to section
Scroll page to view dynamic top progress bar update and active navigation highlights
Click mobile hamburger toggle to open and close mobile navigation menu
Click Get In Touch button to jump to contact section

features.name: Hero Section and Credentials Modal
features.description: Hero banner with bio, live vitals badge with ECG waveform, social links, metrics, and modal trigger
user_interactions: Click View Credentials button to open modal with academic credentials and CGPA
Click Hire Me or Explore buttons to navigate to contact or clinical experience
Click social media profile links (LinkedIn, GitHub, Instagram, WhatsApp, Email)

features.name: Clinical Rotations and Modal Breakdowns
features.description: Hospital internship showcase with details and interactive modal breakdown dialogs
user_interactions: Click View Detailed Breakdown for Care24 Medical Centre to open hospital modal
Click View Detailed Breakdown for Maruthi Medical Centre to open hospital modal
Close modal via close button, escape key, or clicking backdrop

features.name: Skills Matrix and Capabilities
features.description: Categorized technical skills matrix covering biomedical instrumentation, IoT hardware, and software tools
user_interactions: Hover over skill badges and proficiency meters to view capabilities

features.name: Contact Form Submission
features.description: Interactive contact form with input validation, message dispatch via Web3Forms, and real-time status feedback
user_interactions: Enter name in Name input field
Enter email address in Email input field
Enter message in Message textarea
Click Send Message button to submit form
View submission status (sending spinner, success message, or error message)
Click direct contact links for Email, WhatsApp, and location details

features.name: Interactive Modal Dialog
features.description: Reusable accessible modal popup for displaying credentials and detailed hospital rotation logs
user_interactions: View modal content for credentials or clinical rotations
Press Escape key to dismiss modal
Click close icon button to dismiss modal
Click overlay backdrop to dismiss modal
